author: Nintenkid
quote: Ocarina of Time is an important and influential game, but it is nowhere near perfect and does not deserve a 99 on Metacritic.Released in 1998 on the N64, it pioneered 3D action-adventure conventions (Z-targeting, a large explorable world, dungeon design that influenced a generation). Its soundtrack, sense of scale, and key moments (the time-travel shift, the final Ganon fight) are genuinely strong. None of that equates to near-flawless execution. A 99 implies something essentially perfect; this game has clear, well-documented design problems that later versions of the series (and even remakes of this title) had to fix.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Nintenkid
quote: This is my first time playing any Zelda game, and I just don't get the hype, the game is boring, you mostly just walk around for ages, you eventually get a horse but that's not until hours into the game, the game is way too easy and there's no option to change the difficulty, this game also lacks Modern QOL options, don't waste your time on this one.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Nintenkid
quote: The best game of the year, and it does not dissapoint, the story was very relatable, exploration is vast, it really rewards you for exploring outside the main story,  truly a masterpiece, give this one a go, you're going to have alot of fun.
